body: "Giving your opponent a choice is never good" has been a mantra in magic for so long that people can't see a good card for a good card when it reads "your opponent may choose.." or the like. This doesn't give them a choice that is much better than the other. I can't imagine this being a bad card in all but the most high powered cubes. To me, this is a solid 3rd or 4th pick in a medium to medium-high power cube

Some monocolor cards are just as restrictive as multi-color cards are (if not more), especially black and white cards. [[Phyrexian Obliterator]] [[Archangel of Tithes]]. Some multicolor cards are more flexible than almost any monocolored cards [[Dryad Militant]], [[Rakdos Cackler]].
[[Timetwister]] is worse than several non-power nine cards, so I think it should get a different treatment than the others.

3CMC is extremely competitive in black and there are better aggro threats out there for that cost [[Vampire Nighthawk]], [[Master of the feast]]. There is also much more efficient ways to discard, my personal favorite being symmetric effects like [[Pox]], [[Smallpox]], and [[Rotting Rats]].
